Definition: from G4633; a hut or temporary residence, i.e. (figuratively) the human body (as the abode of the spirit):--tabernacle.
BiblicalUsage: Skenos is the tabernacle, the earthly house of this body, and Paul says if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens. We that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened, not that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe groaning in the tent is the sound of hope, because the body that aches now is the body that will be clothed with life.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
